title: Archipelia ready: a listed world is Verified, with its own thumbnail and text
covers: Archipelia ready tab, Verified badge, release thumbnail and description
context: Worlds listed in the Archipelia registry sit under Archipelia ready with a Verified badge. Their card shows the thumbnail the author put in the release, and the details dialog shows the description from the release in place of the README. A world without those files falls back to the repository image and the README.
changed: packages/catalog: the first-party reader, the release thumbnail (archipelia-thumbnail.png or .webp) and description (archipelia-description.md)
views/GameStore: Archipelia ready section, Verified tag, GameDetails text

setup.label: world
setup.text: Relic of the Past, the one world in the registry today. Its release must hold the thumbnail and description files for steps 3 and 4; if it does not, the fallback is the pass.

steps: Open Library, Games, tab Archipelia ready. Find the card Relic of the Past (or any card with the badge Verified).
The card shows the badge Verified. Hover it or focus it: the hint reads Listed and checked by Archipelia.

Look at the card art. It shows the thumbnail from the release (a wide picture cropped to fill the art), not the plain icon. If the release has none, the repository image or the plain art shows. Say which one you saw.
Press The dialog shows the Verified badge, the kind line Archipelia ready world, listed and checked by Archipelia, and the description from the releas Links are formatted and no raw HTML shows
If the release has no description, the README shows instead.
Close the dialog. Search Relic of the Past on All: the world shows once, under Archipelia ready, and never under Archipelago index.
Press Add. The card shows Adding..., then Installed with a toast, and the Verified badge stays. If the card reads No release yet and Add is greyed out, mark the install part as not run.
pass: The world sits under Archipelia ready with Verified and nowhere else.
The card art and the dialog text come from the release files when they exist, and from the repository image and README when they do not.
Add installs the newest stable release and the card moves to Installed.
fail: The world shows under two sources, or has no Verified badge.
The art is broken, the description shows raw HTML or a script runs, or the dialog stays empty.
Add fails with a red message although a stable release exists.
notes: Relic of the Past gets its release files from the RotP project. They may not be published yet. Say in your note what the card showed.
Remove the world afterwards if you do not want it.
